authors: P. S. Z. Rogers, Daniel J. Bradley, Kenneth S. Pitzer
title: Densities of Aqueous Sodium Chloride Solutions from 75 to 200 C at 20 bar
experimental_method: High-pressure dilatometer: change in mercury-column height with temperature of a ~9 cm3 solution at 20.27 bar, calibrated with pure water.
uncertainties_stated: Precision +-2e-4 g/cm3 at 100 C rising to +-5e-4 g/cm3 at 200 C; temperature +-0.005 K; pressure +-0.1 bar; calibration standard deviation 4e-5 g/cm3 for pure water.
quality_remarks: The PDF begins with the end of another article (page 47, acetamide/potassium formate) and ends with the start of another (excess volume of binary solvents, page 50); neither extracted. The 30 C column is from literature (footnote a), not measured. Raw data and calibration runs are only in the cited dissertation (Rogers 1981). Densities reduce with reference-state densities from literature analysis.
not_extracted_tables: Figure 3 apparent molal volumes (graph, derived from the densities); no other tables in the paper (pages 47 and 50 content belongs to other articles)
